answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via hardware-bound epoch attestation. At the dawn of each epoch, an agent must anchor its key to a randomness beacon using a secure element whose quartz oscillator paces a rate-limited monotonic counter. Because fused endorsement keys and serialized clock ticks prevent multiplexing, an attacker must buy dedicated physical silicon per identity.
